race.title: Irishinjuredjockeys.com Nursery Handicap
race.verdict: PREMIER VIEW has made a promising start to his career and is taken to make a quick return to winning ways. Space Dreamer has to be respected on what she's shown to date, while the steadily progressive Invincible Irish is entitled to be in the mix despite racing from just out of the handicap. PREMIER VIEW (IRE) SPACE DREAMER (IRE) INVINCIBLE IRISH (IRE)
